news.title: SS Rajamouli Reflects on Filming His Most Brutal Sequence with Jr NTR
news.summary: Filmmaker SS Rajamouli has opened up about shooting what he considers the most violent sequence of his entire career alongside actor Jr NTR. Reflecting on the demanding shoot outside the Kerala Assembly, the director expressed doubt over whether filming such a sequence would even be feasible today.
body: Renowned filmmaker SS Rajamouli has shared retrospective insights into a particularly intense milestone in his directorial career. Looking back at a demanding project, the acclaimed director recalled filming what he explicitly identifies as the most violent scene he has ever brought to life on screen.

The challenging sequence featured actor Jr NTR and was notably captured on location outside the Kerala Assembly. According to the filmmaker, the logistical and creative environment of the past allowed for the realization of this intense vision in a way that feels increasingly difficult to replicate under current conditions.

Reflecting on the shifting landscape of film production, Rajamouli admitted uncertainty regarding whether mounting such a brutal and aggressive sequence would be possible in the present day. This commentary offers cinephiles a rare glimpse into the practical evolution of large-scale filmmaking and the changing parameters of cinematic violence.
